itemIds.title: Item IDs
itemIds.description: Numeric Walmart item ids (the number at the end of /ip/ URLs).

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: 10 reviews per page. Use 0 to get only the product row.

includeProduct.title: Include product row
includeProduct.description: Price, availability, category, rating breakdown and Walmart's review summary.

aiInsights.title: AI insights per product (optional)
aiInsights.sectionCaption: 🤖 AI insights (optional, bring your own key)
aiInsights.description: Adds one 'ai-insight' row per product: sentiment %, top pros, cons, themes, feature requests, notable quotes and an executive summary. Requires your own Gemini or OpenAI API key. US$0.20 per 1,000 reviews analyzed from 4 Nov 2026 (free until then); AI tokens are billed by your provider. Off by default.

aiProvider.title: AI provider
aiProvider.description: Leave empty to auto-detect from the key (keys starting with 'sk-' are OpenAI, others Gemini).

aiApiKey.title: AI API key
aiApiKey.description: Your Gemini (aistudio.google.com) or OpenAI key. Used only for the AI calls; stored encrypted and never logged.

aiLanguage.title: AI output language
aiLanguage.description: Language of the AI text (e.g. English, Spanish, Portuguese).
